name: nearcab/sky
title: NearCab Sky (F2)
description: Stop 2, above the city: a washed card next to the zone map. Part A explains the zones, part B (after the route is drawn) lists the four stations from call to curb.

headingA.default: Every cab owns a patch of the city

leadA.default: Each zone holds the streets closer to its cab than to any other.

bodyA.default: A call is answered by finding the zone it falls in, not by measuring the distance to every car.

captionA.default: Eleven cabs, eleven zones. The red pin is the caller.

leadB.default: The slow part is the drive. Everything before it takes seconds.

default.text: The call and the address are logged.
The address lands in one zone.
The cab takes the short way to the door.

mapAlt.default: a painted city map from above with small taxis and a red pin
